# HUPIPLAY (Full Documentation for LLMs)

> HUPIPLAY is a licensed and authorized digital gaming marketplace providing genuine activation CD keys, gaming subscriptions, and gift cards with instant automated digital delivery.

Website: https://hupiplay.uk
API: https://api.hupiplay.uk
Support: info@hupiplay.uk

## Overview
HUPIPLAY connects gamers worldwide with authentic digital games at competitive prices. The store features an extensive catalog of over 70,000 published digital game keys across all major gaming platforms:
- **PC:** Steam, Epic Games Store, GOG.com, EA App (Origin), Ubisoft Connect, Battle.net, Rockstar Games Launcher
- **PlayStation:** PS4 and PS5 digital games, PlayStation Network (PSN) wallet top-ups, PlayStation Plus subscriptions
- **Xbox:** Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One digital codes, Xbox Game Pass Ultimate, Xbox Live Gold
- **Nintendo:** Nintendo Switch digital download codes and eShop prepaid cards

## Key Features
- **Instant Digital Delivery:** Keys are delivered automatically via email and displayed on the user order confirmation screen immediately after successful payment confirmation.
- **Global Currency Support:** Live pricing and checkout available in USD ($), EUR (€), GBP (£), TRY (₺), and SAR (ر.س).
- **Internationalization:** Full multilingual interface supporting English, Turkish, German, French, and Arabic.
- **Secure Payments:** Industry-standard checkout via Stripe (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), PayPal, and direct bank transfers.
